name: Battlement

source.title: Pathfinder rules text (Foundry PF2E trait descriptions)

text: This shield includes a weapon that can't be removed. The weapon's damage is listed alongside the trait, such as "battlement d6 S," with any traits in parentheses. Unless otherwise noted in the shield's description, such a weapon is a martial weapon in the shield weapon group and requires the hand holding the shield to attack with it. You can fight normally with the included weapon if the shield is broken, but if the shield is destroyed, so is the weapon. The included weapon can be improved like other weapon and have weapon upgrades installed but starts with 0 upgrade slots.
